entries.dialogueText: "I can't act with total impunity. My hands are tied by royal tradition."

entries.dialogueText: "I disagree. In fact, a truly benevolent king can meet his people's needs more efficiently than a squabbling parliament."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Even if I agreed with you, cutting ties with Rumburg would be a disaster for us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
